jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad
jobs.content: <p>Hooli's Montreal office builds the data platform behind Hooli Analytics. We are hiring new graduates to join the Ingestion team, where you will ship production code in your first month with a dedicated mentor.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Build and operate Python services that ingest and validate billions of events a day</li><li>Design REST APIs with FastAPI backed by PostgreSQL</li><li>Write tests, review code and join a mentored on-call rotation</li></ul><h3>What we're looking for</h3><ul><li>A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, completed by summer 2027</li><li>Strong Python fundamentals</li><li>Experience with SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)</li><li>Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines</li><li>Kubernetes experience is a plus</li></ul><p>This is a hybrid role based in our Montreal office, 3 days a week on site. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.</p>

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Lead the design of Hooli's billing services and mentor a team of five engineers.</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>7+ years of backend development experience</li><li>Deep experience with Go or Java and distributed systems</li><li>Track record of leading cross-team technical projects</li></ul><p>Hybrid in Toronto. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.</p>

jobs.title: Software Engineer, University Graduate
jobs.content: <p>Join Hooli's headquarters engineering program for recent university graduates.</p><h3>Minimum qualifications</h3><ul><li>BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience</li><li>Experience with one or more general-purpose languages: Python, Java, C++ or Go</li><li>Must be authorized to work in the United States</li></ul><p>Onsite in Mountain View, CA or New York, NY. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.</p>
